seed_rule: SeedSequence([20261102, n_r, stage, batch_id]); stages 0=find, 1=independent evaluation, 2=bootstrap

grid.root_interpolation: piecewise linear with bracketed Brent refinement

intervals.bootstrap: percentile over reoptimized batch-mean curves; positions conditional on two minima

criteria.stable_double_valley: two internal minima and at least one internal maximum; positive lower 95% curvature bounds; coarse/fine agreement; at least 95% bootstrap support; no unresolved local refinement
criteria.direction_resolved: independent paired 95% interval, conservatively expanded by the quadratic root-position error, excludes zero
criteria.risk_support: entire position-expanded 95% interval for n_r Delta_n lies within [0.9 C_Delta, 1.1 C_Delta]
criteria.risk_unsupported: position-expanded 95% interval for n_r Delta_n has no intersection with the tolerance band

reasons: bootstrap root structure in the indeterminate band
escalation.rule: double both find-root and independent-evaluation budgets; retain every attempt; stop when resolved or at the 8x cap

risk_definition: exact conditional-label-noise full-ridge risk averaged over independent exact Bartlett Gram pairs; not R0+R1/n
position_rule: roots of the Monte Carlo average conditional derivative; never an average of per-dataset argmins
